content: Official ClubSpark customer recurring-session guide (2024-08-23) documents website discovery, venue filtering, session selection, participant selection and payment choice (https://sportlabs.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404661659793-How-To-Book-A-Recurring-Session-Course). CourtReserve team-registration guide (2026-07-08) documents registering a guest partner without full membership and manual admin registration, but its two-player team model does not establish arbitrary Lafu group booking (https://help.courtreserve.com/en/articles/11429176-team-based-events-create-an-event). Lafu numbered multi-place guests and phone OTP are approved local requirements, not assumed competitor equivalence.
